Mrt Music Presents "Kogile Haadide" Hd Video Song From The Evergreen Kannada Movie "Samayada Gombe", Starring Dr. Rajkumar And Roopa Devi. This Beautiful Classic Kannada Melody Is Sung By S. Janaki, With Music Composed By The Legendary M. Ranga Rao.
Enjoy This Evergreen Kannada Old Hit Song In Hd And Relive The Golden Memories Of Classic Kannada Cinema. Listen To Timeless Kannada Melodies, Beautiful Old Kannada Songs And Memorable Songs From The Golden Era Of Kannada Film Music.
Directed by: Dorai–Bhagavan
Produced by: Dorai–Bhagavan, Rathi Radhakrishna
Written by: Chi. Udayashankar
